describesHead.landingTitle: docs(arch): record the parser decision, ownership, reuse and lineage (#812)

activationSource.record: FrameworkActivation { package, framework, state: active | inactive | unsupported-version | off, admittedRelease, mode, provenance }
activationSource.familyRow: crates/verter_session/src/framework/families/astro.rs (REG0 module; the activation row is data there)
activationSource.abortCheck: FWA1 publishes one record per workspace package and file with the resolved installed version checked against this family's version lock, so a per-package, version-admitted astro activation is expressible; the AST0 abort condition does not apply.

activationRow.perFileNarrowing: none: astro has no file pragma; activation is per owning package

values.auto: active only when the owning package resolves the astro package to an admitted release
values.on: active only at an admitted release; on names astro-7.3.8 or the record is unsupported-version; with no manifest entry, provenance is explicit
values.off: the whole Astro vertical is off for every file of the package

switch.readThrough: CFG0 declarative configuration capture; user config is never evaluated

states.when: resolved installed astro equals an admitted release, switch auto or on
states.work: the gated astro LanguageRow is reachable for the package's .astro files

states.when: no resolved astro dependency and switch auto
resolved astro is any version that is not exactly an admitted release (5.x, 6.x, another 7.x patch or minor, 7.4.0-beta.1), or on names an unadmitted release
states.work: zero, and the reason is reported through the FWA1 explain output

gate.bit: ProjectCapabilitySnapshot astro capability bit, set only from an active FWA1 record
gate.wiredBy: AST1M (AST1M-AC5); AST1 keeps the row inert in production and injects the capability in tests
gate.fallback: with the bit off a .astro file resolves to the gated fallback with zero parse work

zeroWorkWhenInactive.rule: When the record is not active for the owning package, the Astro vertical does no parse, fact, projection, lint or format work for that package.

receivers.acceptance: AST9-AC1 (joins every admitted cell to a passing fixture, including the inactive-switch fixture that AST10-AC2 documents)

forbiddenActivation.rule: The .astro extension, a file path, a directory name (src/pages) or an astro.config.* file never activates Astro.
No second activation source beside FWA1: no LSP-local, lint-local (LK6), grammar-local (AST1G TextMate), descriptor-local or config-file probe.
A declared range is never read; activation reads the resolved installed version (VID0 R08).
A floating, latest, canary, beta or legacy-major resolution never activates and is never coerced to the admitted release (VID0 R06, R07).
VS Code TextMate colouring (AST1G) is client-side and lexical; it is never an activation and never product evidence.
